interface.source: problem.txt port list; all ports one bit

semantics.timing: Continuous combinational wires, no cycle latency or stored state, from original wire connections
semantics.reset: No reset or clock ports specified
semantics.initialization: No initialized state; outputs follow current inputs including unknown/high-impedance values under wire semantics

numeric.operations: Signal routing only; no arithmetic, rounding, overflow or signed interpretation

verification.oracle: Original problem connections a -> w, b -> x and y, c -> z
verification.coverage: All 8 binary combinations and all 64 combinations of 0,1,x,z
verification.sampling: Check after one simulation time unit of combinational settling; no clock edges apply
verification.failure: $fatal on any case-inequality mismatch and bounded timeout
verification.tools: Required smoke_environment.py then validate_contract.py then dev_check.py --label initial
